prompt:

Asset type: final native high-resolution landscape Open Graph social-sharing artwork for FixFlags. Background plate only; typography will be added separately.
Input image role: material and exact folded-F silhouette reference only.
Primary request: Create a beautiful premium studio still life of the FixFlags folded-F sculpture in exquisite clear optical glass with vivid Flag Orange #FF5A00 refraction, on a seamless warm paper-white background. Match the supplied brand reference precisely in silhouette and material, but create a fresh wider composition with exceptionally crisp native detail.
Composition: LANDSCAPE 1.905:1 aspect ratio, preferably 2400x1260 pixels or larger. Reserve the entire LEFT 60 percent as very quiet clean warm-white negative space for typography. Place the COMPLETE glass folded F in the RIGHT THIRD, centered at 80 percent across and 50 percent down. The sculpture occupies about 26 percent of the total canvas width and 74 percent height, with at least 10 percent clear margin above and below. Entire object must be visible. Two precisely shaped coplanar pieces, a tall angular upper-and-stem piece with positive diagonal top edge and separate parallelogram crossbar. Preserve exact logo identity, no extra bars.
Visual treatment: jewel-like transparent glass faces, restrained saturated orange core, fine polished bevels, crisp specular highlights, realistic refraction. Slight front three-quarter angle, minimal depth. Warm studio light from upper left. Beautiful subtle orange caustic and soft grounded shadow directly below the sculpture, fading naturally into the warm matte paper background. Background hue approximately #F9F8F6. Sophisticated extremely restrained editorial composition with exquisite physical material detail.
Constraints: absolutely NO words, typography, letters except the folded-F sculpture, captions, badges, UI, screens, mock data, numbers, decoration, pedestal, watermark, border, frames or additional objects. No ambient fog, grain, pixelation, jagged edges, excessive bloom, rainbow fringes or black edge outlines. Keep the left 60 percent softly lit and unobstructed. This should look like a meticulous luxury product photograph in FixFlags brand colors.
composition: Typography and the official vector wordmark are composed by scripts/generate-social-card.mts.
